_readme: THE MACHINE PARTY, ROUND ONE (SOUNDS 10/19/26, row [the machine party], rule 121(k)). REPO MAN remade: HIS row, note for note (the name too: his engine draws the tune from the name's length, so the name is the tune), played by his own engine, with a real machine plugged into it (engine/bohemia_machine_party.js, the kit in slices/vote/songs/machine_party_kit/ from CC0 recordings of real machines). Recorded by tools/bohemia_sounds_machine_party_record.js; gate gates/the_machine_party_gate.js. The alpha does not load it until his YES (a CUE row, RUN's).
name: REPO MAN, THE MACHINE PARTY

press.on: his kick (drumV with the row's kit.k)
press.is: a coupling slamming between two train wagons

relay.on: his hat (drumV with the row's kit.h)

party.is: the press on beats two and four in his D sections: four to the bar

clank.is: steel on steel on the and of two, every other bar

motor.is: a washing machine's motor whining on G3, changing speed with his key moves; louder in his C sections, where the song strips to kick and bass

hall.is: one concrete hall, 10 x 18 x 7 m, the machine wetter than the music

tape.is: the from-a-recording tool's tape: a head bump, a soft tanh, wow and flutter, a gentle 2:1, a 9 kHz top

card.title: REPO MAN, REMADE AS A MACHINE PARTY
card.why: Your REPO MAN, every note, played by the game's own music engine with real machines playing along: a train coupling on every kick, an old clock on every hat, and a washing machine's motor humming in your key, in a concrete hall on a worn tape (A) or clean (C), beside your REPO MAN as the map plays it now (B). You hear it on this page over the real map, and on the map once you say yes; EYES AND EARS is paused, so nobody checked it beside your songs first.
options: A, the machine party, in the hall on tape
B, keep REPO MAN as it is
